question: Does the published native NCC brigatinib response extend to the fixed available ALK-directed scaffold/formulation comparison, or remain compound-specific in the reported source?
prior_art: Brigatinib is already highlighted in Iwata2025. This is not a newly nominated drug, ranking, dependency claim or refutation of an author ALK claim; no author ALK-dependency assertion verified. Prior whole-screen values were already evaluated, so this is exploratory reuse, not blinded discovery.
practical_consequence: Only a reproducible source-compatible discordance could prioritize a discriminating matched brigatinib versus ceritinib/crizotinib follow-up in additional native models, rather than selecting generic ALK perturbation from drug names. One-model source summaries alone do not clear publication value.
formulation_rule: No salts/enantiomers collapsed. S-crizotinib selectivity is unverified here and is not assumed ALK-equivalent. CAS matching governs literal IC50 crosswalk, not display-name identity.
endpoints: NCC reported screening viability percent and source SD, separately reported nM IC50; USZ20 ordinal source category separately. Never pooled across assays or normalized into common potency.
permitted_calculation: Literal selected means/SD/IC50/ordinal extraction; fixed each IC50/brigatinib ratio and screen mean difference versus brigatinib, explicitly descriptive and not an inferential/compatible-exposure claim. No rank, refit, p value, CI or arbitrary cutoff.
compatibility_gate: NCC exact dose, duration, control, readout and raw replicate hierarchy unverified; no drug-class or target interpretation until authenticated. Source SD is not donor uncertainty and IC50 CI unavailable.
all_model_coverage: USZ20 full40 native, USZ22 distinct selected validation has no authenticated selected-family condition; NCC native221 plus selected24, USZ23/old cultures/native CIVO and generic ex-vivo statuses retained in prior records. Missing measured conditions remain pending, not resistance.
strongest_alternative: Different exposure, assay normalization, dose-curve construction, off-target effects, formulations or stereoselectivity could explain response differences. Broad phenotype in one model is not disease-wide or clinical efficacy.
defeat: No authenticated common condition/control schema or no reproducible distinct contrast beyond published highlights defeats promotion. All relevant accessible suitable pending conditions block advancement.
